name: M3_PPS170MI_GeneratePONbr
description: Generate and assign a purchase order number for a single planned purchase order. The operation identifies the record by its internal planned order number together with its two subnumbers, then creates a unique purchase order number and links it to that proposal. It is intended for initial number assignment only and does not re‑generate or change an existing purchase order number. The response also returns information about the supplier rebate agreement model and whether the order contributes to supplier rebate totals.

inputParameters.name: PLPN
inputParameters.description: Internal number identifying the planned purchase order for which the purchase order number is generated.

inputParameters.name: PLPS
inputParameters.description: Subnumber identifying the specific part of the planned purchase order for which the purchase order number is generated.

inputParameters.name: PLP2
inputParameters.description: Secondary subnumber further identifying the planned purchase order instance for which the purchase order number is generated.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Newly generated purchase order number assigned to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: SRAM
outputParameters.description: Supplier rebate agreement model applied to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: SRGR
outputParameters.description: Indicator whether the item on the planned purchase order contributes to supplier rebate generating or paying totals.
